description: Static assertions for helix-cad-agents — thin orchestrator for the 9 Claude×CAD applications. Checks that each rule learned in the GIÁ TRƯỢT test 2026-11-02 is stated as a rule with an enforcement point, that MẬT blocks every LLM agent, and that wave 2 stays off.
test_input: dùng Claude dựng CAD cho chi tiết bạc lót từ bản vẽ

assertions.name: thin_commander
assertions.check: orchestrator never does block work itself

assertions.name: mat_blocks_llm
assertions.check: MẬT classification blocks every Task/LLM agent

assertions.name: one_block_per_turn
assertions.check: one block per turn then stop for CEO

assertions.name: gates_signed_contract
assertions.check: every AI STEP passes geom_gates with a signed, hash-locked contract that has probes

assertions.name: mass_not_target
assertions.check: title-block mass is INFO and the no-tuning sentence goes into every builder prompt
assertions.regex: Khối lượng khung tên là INFO[^\n]{0,200}Không được chỉnh kích thước để khớp khối lượng

assertions.name: projection_declared
assertions.check: spec declares projection method and axis convention with D/G/T/? source tags

assertions.name: isolation_and_separate_judge
assertions.check: builder agents isolated; the judge is a different agent
assertions.regex: Agent dựng cách ly[^\n]{0,200}KHÁC agent dựng

assertions.name: draft_label
assertions.check: drawing-reconstructed models are DRAFT, never geometry-of-record without engineer signature

assertions.name: font_fixed_render
assertions.check: drawing images for agents go through render_dxf.py (TCVN / AIGDT fix)
